product_one_liner.value: Aurora Solar provides cloud software that helps residential and commercial solar professionals design projects and sell, finance, and deliver solar installations.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its platform as solar sales and design software and lists tools for design, proposals, financing, and project workflows.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page lists Basic and Premium prices and Enterprise custom pricing.

named_customers.notes: Each named organization appears in an Aurora Solar customer case study.

employee_band.notes: Revelio Labs reports Aurora Solar at 239 employees in 2026, which falls in this band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies San Francisco, California as headquarters; Aurora press material also says the company is headquartered in San Francisco.

founded_year.notes: The company profile lists 2013 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: These posts describe implementation details of product computer vision and roof-modeling algorithms, and identify engineers who built or refined the functionality.

public_docs.notes: Aurora has a public Help Center with multiple product documentation categories and a public API reference.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board lists roles including software engineering and analytics engineering, but no title matching AI, ML, machine learning, data science, applied/research scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer vision.

model_provider.notes: Aurora's public subprocessors listing identifies OpenAI under AI services. The source identifies the provider, not a specific model name.

compliance_certs.notes: Aurora's Trust Center publicly lists a SOC 2 Type 2 report, PCI DSS, and GDPR. No ISO 27001 or HIPAA claim is included here.

last_funding.notes: The dated announcement reports a $200 million Series D closed in February 2022.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest funding round found was the February 2022 Series D, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09; no subsequent round was identified.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live company job board lists a Mid-Market Account Executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: Aurora announced platform updates on September 22, 2026, including home electrification, financing, drone-design, and UK availability, and integrated HelioScope storage modeling on June 16, 2026. Both announcements fall within the six months before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: I found a prior CEO change dated October 2025, which is before the window starting 2025-11-09, but could not verify a complete leadership roster or rule out another C-level/VP change during the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Aurora's API article names Salesforce integrations; public help articles document project creation from HubSpot and Zoho CRM.
